title: Encouraging SMEs to Protect Their Intellectual Property Business Interests
what_it_is: Encouraging SMEs to Protect Their Intellectual Property Business Interests

sections.label: GoBusiness IP Grow platform launch
sections.summary: Under SIPS 2030, the Government launched GoBusiness IP Grow in 2023 to support enterprises' IP needs and global growth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As part of SIPS 2030, the Government launched the GoBusiness IP Grow platform in 2023 to better support the enterprises' IP needs and to help them grow and expand globally.

sections.label: IP consultations and enterprise touchpoints
sections.summary: First-timers get a complimentary 45-minute IP consultation, and over 15 enterprise touchpoints were set up island-wide.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: First-timers can receive a complimentary 45-minute consultation session with participating service providers to receive advice on IP strategy and matters concerning expanding into overseas markets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To help enterprises leverage IP to drive business growth, the Government has set up more than 15 enterprise touchpoints island-wide at Startup Accelerators and Incubators, as well as SME Centres that are run by trade associations and chambers (TACs).

sections.label: Grants offsetting IP costs
sections.summary: Enterprise Development Grant offsets IP fees and Market Readiness Assistance Grant covers overseas IP registration costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: To address companies' feedback on the costs of IP protection, Enterprise Singapore's Enterprise Development Grant offsets the IP fees that the companies incur when developing innovative and new products, and the Market Readiness Assistance Grant covers IP registration costs in overseas markets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Government will continue to support our SMEs in leveraging IP for growth locally and internationally and to strengthen Singapore's position as a Global-Asia node for technology, innovation and enterprise.
